title: Fennec Shand at the Ready
description: Despite the head start that the assassins took, Fennec Shand is effective with keeping up with them. Nearly catching them, Shand is driven off by a barrage of projectile attacks. When the two warriors continue to flee, Fennec is quick to cut them off. Still on the rooftops, another melee battle ensues. Although it's 2 on 1, Fennec doesn't take much time to acquire the weapon carried by one of the crimson-clad assailants, kicking him off the ledge and taking his pal into custody.
